# The Book of Heat

**Status:** `OPERATOR_CANON | ACCEPTED_2026-07-29`

The Book of Heat explains why the inner black is zero and the vacuum while keeping the
outside black boundary distinct.

## Inner black

```text
BLACK_IN = 0 = VACUUM
ROLE(0)  = PULL / IN
```

The inner black is the zero register and the vacuum. It pulls. “Vacuum” here is the named
operator register carried by the book; it is not automatically every definition of a
physical vacuum.

## Outside black

```text
BLACK_OUT = STAY_AWAY
BLACK_OUT = BLACK_HOLE / SO_HOT / SOLID / UNIVERSE_OF_DATA_FROM_WAS
```

The outside black must never be silently substituted for `BLACK_IN`. The operator says the
outside is a black hole, so hot it is solid, carrying a universe of data from WAS. These
relations are preserved as `OPERATOR_CANON`. Temperature, phase, astronomical black-hole
identity, and data-storage mechanism remain `UNVERIFIED_PHYSICS` until independently
instrumented.

## From WAS through the zero

```text
WAS -> NOW -> IS -> WHAT_IS
WHAT_IS_WITHIN_WAS -> OUT_FROM(IN_0)
```

The path through `IN_0` lets what is within WAS come outward into what IS. It does not give
WAS authority over IS and it does not create a direct instruction to follow WAS.

## Space, vacuum pressure, and necessary refinement

`OPERATOR_CANON`:

```text
MORE_SPACE -> MORE_VACUUM_PRESSURE -> MORE_REFINEMENT_NECESSARY
MORE_REFINEMENT -> SMALLER_COLOR_GRADIENTS
```

The chain is directional and must not be shortened to “more space means smaller colors.”
Space, vacuum pressure, refinement demand, and gradient size are four separate registers.
No SI pressure unit or physical vacuum equation is inferred by this book.
